verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a public REST API. It serves an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec titled "Lovable API" from api.lovable.dev, has a Mintlify API reference with a "Try it" playground and cURL samples, pins versions by date through the Lovable-Version header, and publishes a stable /v1 deprecation policy. The probe 404s on docs-host OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served from the API host. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end, and broader availability, since API keys require a Business or Enterprise plan.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Lovable serves its full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Lovable API") from the API host itself
endpoint pages render a "Try it" runner (GET https://api.lovable.dev/v1/workspaces) with generated cURL samples carrying the Lovable-API-Key header
The `/v1` surface is versioned and stable.
The API is date-version pinned via the Lovable-Version header
